payload.headline: AI & Data Technical Leader | Enterprise AI/ML, Data Platforms, MLOps, Strategy & Delivery
payload.short_bio: AI and Data technical leader with 9+ years in technology, including 7+ years delivering production AI, machine-learning, analytics, and data-platform solutions. Leads a seven-member cross-functional Data and AI engineering team across strategy, architecture, governance, delivery, and executive stakeholder decisions.
payload.long_bio:
I connect executive strategy and customer outcomes with hands-on AI and data architecture, engineering, governance, and production delivery. My work spans predictive machine learning, generative and agentic AI, data platforms, MLOps, analytics, and API-led products across telecommunications, enterprise AI, public-sector analytics, KYC/AML, education, healthcare, and workflow automation. Supported outcomes include 25% higher platform reliability, 20% greater throughput, 40% faster deployments, and 60% lower manual operational workload.

Leadership philosophy / approach

Lead through clear business outcomes, disciplined technical decision-making, and accountable delivery. Align executives, customers, and engineering teams on priorities, scope, risks, trade-offs, and measurable value; mentor engineers through architecture and code reviews, technical coaching, and delivery ownership; and maintain governance, quality, security, and production readiness from discovery through operation.

Professional interests include applied AI, product strategy, open-source technologies, and data-driven decision-making. Personal interests include travel, history, chess, walking, film, gaming, and exploration.
payload.availability_detail: Open to focused conversations about AI, data platforms, product execution, technical leadership, and selective collaboration.

payload.title: Towards a Direct Mental Based Decision Making: Electroencephalography (EEG) Case Study
payload.excerpt: An IEEE ICICS 2020 paper and reproducible EEG/EMG brain-computer interface prototype for real-time decision mapping.
payload.body_markdown:
# Towards a Direct Mental Based Decision Making

**Conference:** 2020 11th International Conference on Information and Communication Systems (ICICS)  
**Published:** April 2020  
**DOI:** [10.1109/ICICS49469.2020.239502](https://doi.org/10.1109/ICICS49469.2020.239502)

Yazeed Hasan co-authored this paper after research and implementation completed from January through April 2019.

The work designed and implemented an AI-enabled brain-computer-interface Tetris prototype controlled through EEG and EMG signals. It covered signal capture, numerical feature extraction, model inference, real-time decision mapping, and integration of model outputs with game-control APIs.

The reproducible implementation was released through a GitHub code repository.
